claims: The CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 was announced on April 15, 2026.
The total pass percentage of the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 was 93.70%.
24,71,777 students appeared for the CBSE Class 10 2026.
23,16,008 students successfully passed the CBSE Class 10 2026.
The pass percentage of the CBSE Class 10 Result 2025 was 93.66%.
Girls had a pass percentage of 94.99% in the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026.
Boys had a pass percentage of 92.69% in the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026.
Trivandrum and Vijayawada topped with a 99.79% pass rate in the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026.
Chennai had a 99.58% pass rate in the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026.
Kendriya Vidyalayas achieved a 99.57% pass rate in the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026.
Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas achieved a 99.42% pass rate in the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026.
Compartment Exams for CBSE Class 10 2026 are scheduled to start in mid-May 2026.
